passages.text: Greed doesn’t give rise to contentment. Rather, greed just gives rise to greed. Hate doesn’t give rise to love. Rather, hate just gives rise to hate. Delusion doesn’t give rise to understanding. Rather, delusion just gives rise to delusion.
passages.note: Hate breeds hate; greed never brings contentment

passages.text: A white lotus, fragrant and delightful, sprouts in water and grows there, but water does not stick to it. Just so the Buddha is born in the world, and lives in the world, but the world does not stick to him, as water does not stick to the lotus.
passages.note: Living in the world without being stained by it
